newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine farmers enjoying harvest weather.
newsitem.headline: Argentine farmers enjoying harvest weather.

text.p: Argentine farmers were in the fields harvesting Friday, although storms were forecast in the grain belt towards evening, traders said.
"They are harvesting like crazy," a trader said, adding there was not much concern in the market that the storms would cause major problems or delays to the wheat harvest.

The Argentine government's Meteorological Service forecast isolated storms in the south and center of key Buenos Aires province. In northern Buenos Aires it forcecast a hot day with the possibility of rain in the afternoon.

Weather in La Pampa province was said to be unstable, with maximum temperatures nearing 95 degrees Fahrenheit (35 degrees Celsius). There was a possibility of storms and hot weather in Cordoba and Santa Fe.
